paragraphs.text: Streaming video preview for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI sidebar: mp4/webm/mov play in place over an
authenticated byte-range route (206), no size cap, no build step and zero dependencies.
# dsh-video-preview
A **video preview** for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI sidebar. Click an `.mp4`, `.webm` or `.mov
` in the file tree, an `@` reference, or the workspace-changes list, and it plays in place — instead
of "preview is not available for this file type yet".
DSH's built-in document preview registers text, PDF, Excel and images. **Video is not one of them.**
This plugin adds that renderer: `mp4` / `m4v` / `webm` / `ogv` / `ogg` / `mov`.
> 中文说明：README.zh.md
## Features
- **Click and play** — suffix-matched renderer that streams the file from an authenticated host rout

e.
- **True streaming** — the `<video>` element talks to a byte-range route (`206 Partial Content`),
so **seeking is instant and file size has no complete-read cap**: a 5 GB video costs only the bytes

you actually watch.
- **Muted autoplay** — browsers refuse audible autoplay, so the preview starts

silently; the native controls unmute in one click.
- **Useful metadata** — filename, container forma

t, size (from a stat route).
- **Readable failures** — an unsupported codec or container says so ins

tead of showing a blank player.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — React comes from the host; everyth
ing else is standard Node/browser API. **No build step**: the browser half is a hand-written `__Modu

leLoader__` module.
- **No host coupling** — the browser half registers through the public `document
Previews` / `slots` / `locale` services; the host half through `connection.fetch` routes inside the
same browser-auth fence as every other `/api` route.

## Use

1. Type `@` in the composer and pick a video file (or open one from the workspace changes).
2. Click

the file reference; the right sidebar opens a player and starts muted playback.
3. Drag, unmute, go
fullscreen with the native controls. Seeking fetches only the bytes around the new position.
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `rangeBytes` | `2097152` (2 MiB) | Byte window served per stream request. The browser issues conse
cutive ranges as it plays, so this is a latency/throughput knob, not a size limit. |
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Limitations
| Limit | Cause | Workaround |

| No `mkv` | Chrome cannot decode Matroska | Remux to mp4/webm |
| Codec-dependent | The browser onl

y plays what the platform decodes; HEVC/AV1 vary | H.264/AAC mp4 is the safe choice |
| Session must
resolve | The stream route resolves the file through the session named in the file address | Previe

wing files from a live session always resolves; a vanished session 404s |
| Authenticated browsers o
nly | Routes live behind the same auth fence as the rest of `/api` | That is the point — no unauthen
ticated file serving |
## How it works
| Half | File | Role |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `GET/HEAD /api/video-preview.stream` (byte ranges via `workspace
Files.readBytes(range)`, `206` + `Content-Range`) and `GET /api/video-preview.stat` (size/version/ty

pe) on `connection.fetch` |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | Registers the renderer metadata (`loading:
"renderer"`) and the keyed document body; renders `<video src=…>` pointed at the stream route and r
eports its loaded version |
The renderer uses `loading: "renderer"`, so the preview framework never performs a complete-byte rea
d for video files — that is what removes the platform's 32 MB complete-file cap from the video path.
The browser half needs no build step — it is a module in the host loader's own format:

## Related
dsh-web-guard — the same author's password login for the DSH Web UI, so it can be exposed on the int
ernet: sign in from anywhere instead of chasing one-off tokens, with reverse-proxy quirks handled. T
his plugin only changes how files preview, not who can open them: if the UI is reachable beyond loop
back, put dsh-web-guard in front of it.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Development
`main` is the release branch: it only carries code that has been released and tagged. Day-to-day wor
k happens on `dev` and lands on `main` when a release is cut.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Shadow instance (isolated `DSH_HOME`, never touches a live profile or its data):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`test/shadow.patch.yml` mounts the plugin by path. `test/e2e.mjs` drives headless Chrome through "@
reference → click → assert the `<video>` plays, serves 206 ranges, and can seek near the end of a fi
le bigger than the old 32 MB cap". `test/record-demo.mjs` records `docs/demo.gif` from the same flow
(needs `puppeteer-core` and a Chrome binary).
To verify the streaming path through the auth gate — the production topology — install dsh-web-guard
into the same shadow profile, boot it with `test/guard.patch.yml`, and run `test/e2e-guard.mjs`: it
signs in, opens a video, and asserts `206` + `Content-Range` still arrive through the proxy.
## Changelog
- **1.0.0** — first stable release: streaming byte-range host routes, renderer-owned loading, no com

plete-file size cap, `rangeBytes` config.
- **0.1.0** — preview: Blob-based playback of complete byt
es (32 MB platform cap applied).
